author: Arnav
problem: A telegram office charges per_word for every word in a message. Return the cost of sending the message, rounded to cents.
bug_description: Splits on a single space instead of any whitespace, so doubled, leading or trailing spaces (and an empty message) produce empty 'words' that are charged.

comments.accurate: Charges per_word for each word in the message, rounded to cents
comments.wrong_behavior: Charges per_word for each space-separated piece of the message, rounded to cents
comments.wrong_location: Word split verified; rounding may need to happen per word rather than on the total
